d:
The Heat defeated the Rockets, 128-110 tonight in Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed a team-high 20 points to go with 3 blocks 13 rebounds and 6 assists, with Klay Thompson of the Heat adding an additional 17 points (5-10 FG, 5-8 3P) in the game. Alperen Sengun finished with a team-high 23 points along with 7 rebounds for the Rockets in the losing effort. The Heat improve their record to 8-6 with the win, while the Rockets fall to 11-4 for the season.
